description.value: Creatures can't gain advantage on saves against your poisons, and you have advantage on Dexterity (Sleight of Hand) checks made to hide the act of applying one. When you coat a weapon or its ammunition with poison, that dose now lasts for one additional hit or covers one additional piece of ammunition, and when a Sneak Attack you deal would also deal poison damage, you can convert the Sneak Attack damage into poison damage.
